verdict.rationale: First-party docs show all three pillars on one platform. Spend is covered by cards, virtual cards, receipts and reimbursements. Bill pay runs from invoice to PO match, GL coding, approval and payment, positioned against Bill.com. Banking is covered by a Ramp Checking Account with same-day ACH and wires, an Investment Account and a Banking API. A customer story says Studs replaced 4 tools with Ramp, and one hands-on community report confirms the card and expense side works well. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that bill pay and banking actually replace standalone tools (consolidation claims are vendor case studies), and banking that is not US-only (deposits are held through a partner bank because Ramp is not itself a bank).
